info.description: Describes administrative endpoints for creating, updating, patching, deleting, profiling, reindexing, and inspecting catalogs and data products. Users can learn how to manage catalog metadata, data product metadata, classifiers, required and default sort variables, external resources, changelog entries, refresh history, prepackaged data, documents, metadata imports, process details, and available data product types.
